# social — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Social signals: crypto news, market sentiment, vibe / KOL chatter. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl social <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### social news-latest
Latest crypto news feed (across all coins by default)
`ocl social news-latest [options]`
- `--token-symbols <TOKEN_SYMBOLS>` — Comma-separated coin symbols (e.g. BTC,ETH)
- `--begin <BEGIN>` — Begin timestamp (Unix ms)
- `--end <END>` — End timestamp (Unix ms)
- `--importance <IMPORTANCE>` — Importance: 1=High, 2=Medium, 3=Low
- `--platform <PLATFORM>` — Single platform identifier (see `social news-platforms`)
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Page size, range [1, 50] (default 10)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Pagination cursor from the previous response
- `--detail-level <DETAIL_LEVEL>` — Detail level: 1=Summary, 2=Full
- `--language <LANGUAGE>` — Locale (e.g. en_US, zh_CN)
- `--since <SINCE>` — Relative time window: <int><s|m|h|d>, e.g. 24h, 7d
- `--max-results <MAX_RESULTS>` — Auto-paginate up to N total entries (1-500, max 10 pages) → {items,nextCursor,fetchedCount}

### social news-by-symbol
News filtered by coin symbol(s)
`ocl social news-by-symbol --token-symbols <TOKEN_SYMBOLS> [options]`
- `--sort-by <SORT_BY>` — Sort: 1=Latest (default), 2=Hot
- `--sentiment <SENTIMENT>` — Sentiment: 1=Bullish, 2=Bearish, 3=Neutral
- `--importance <IMPORTANCE>` — Importance: 1=High, 2=Medium, 3=Low
- `--platform <PLATFORM>`
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Page size, range [1, 50] (default 10)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>`
- `--detail-level <DETAIL_LEVEL>`
- `--begin <BEGIN>` — Begin timestamp (Unix ms)
- `--end <END>` — End timestamp (Unix ms)
- `--language <LANGUAGE>`
- `--since <SINCE>` — Relative time window: <int><s|m|h|d>, e.g. 24h, 7d
- `--max-results <MAX_RESULTS>` — Auto-paginate up to N total entries (1-500, max 10 pages) → {items,nextCursor,fetchedCount}

### social news-search
Full-text news search
`ocl social news-search --keyword <KEYWORD> [options]`
- `--sort-by <SORT_BY>`
- `--sentiment <SENTIMENT>`
- `--importance <IMPORTANCE>`
- `--platform <PLATFORM>`
- `--token-symbols <TOKEN_SYMBOLS>` — Comma-separated coin symbols (additional filter, max 20)
- `--begin <BEGIN>` — Begin timestamp (Unix ms)
- `--end <END>` — End timestamp (Unix ms)
- `--detail-level <DETAIL_LEVEL>`
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Page size, range [1, 50] (default 10)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>`
- `--language <LANGUAGE>`
- `--since <SINCE>` — Relative time window: <int><s|m|h|d>, e.g. 24h, 7d
- `--max-results <MAX_RESULTS>` — Auto-paginate up to N total entries (1-500, max 10 pages) → {items,nextCursor,fetchedCount}

### social news-detail
Get the full body of a single article by id
`ocl social news-detail --article-id <ARTICLE_ID> [options]`
- `--language <LANGUAGE>`

### social news-platforms
List available news source platforms (use as `--platform` filters)
`ocl social news-platforms`

### social sentiment-ranking
Top coins ranked by social activity (mention count) over a window
`ocl social sentiment-ranking [options]`
- `--time-frame <TIME_FRAME>` — Statistical period: 1=1h (default), 2=4h, 3=24h
- `--sort-by <SORT_BY>` — Sort: 1=Hot (only value supported)
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Page size, range [1, 50] (default 10)

### social sentiment-symbol
Sentiment metrics for one or more coins (snapshot or time-bucketed trend)
`ocl social sentiment-symbol --token-symbols <TOKEN_SYMBOLS> [options]`
- `--time-frame <TIME_FRAME>` — Statistical period: 1=1h (default), 2=4h, 3=24h
- `--trend-points <TREND_POINTS>` — If > 0, switch to trend mode and return N equally-spaced buckets per coin (max 50)

### social vibe-timeline
Token vibe (hotness) summary + timeline + sample KOLs per bucket
`ocl social vibe-timeline --chain <CHAIN> --token-address <TOKEN_ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--time-frame <TIME_FRAME>` — Time window: 1=24h (default), 2=72h, 3=7d, 4=30d

### social vibe-top-kols
Top KOLs discussing a token (capped at upstream TOP50)
`ocl social vibe-top-kols --chain <CHAIN> --token-address <TOKEN_ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--sort-by <SORT_BY>` — Sort: 1=Engagement (default), 2=Mentions, 3=Impressions
- `--time-frame <TIME_FRAME>`
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Page size (default 20)
